info.name: Net profit
info.definition: Revenue collected, less project costs, supplier bills and running costs paid, and payroll. Revenue: the fee part of what was collected. Costs: what was paid, except payroll, which counts in the month it is for. Payroll counts only for months whose payroll is confirmed; otherwise the figure says "payroll not confirmed".

metrics.name: Revenue collected
metrics.definition: The fee part of the payments received in the period, on the day each was received (cash basis). A payment is split between fee, pass-through and tax in proportion to its invoice; only the fee counts.
metrics.formula: Σ payment × invoice fee ÷ invoice total, payments dated in the period

target.text: At least 55K USD a month

metrics.name: Net profit
metrics.definition: Revenue collected, less project costs, supplier bills and running costs paid, and payroll. Revenue: the fee part of what was collected. Costs: what was paid, except payroll, which counts in the month it is for. Payroll counts only for months whose payroll is confirmed; otherwise the figure says "payroll not confirmed".
metrics.formula: F1 − project costs paid − vendor bills paid − confirmed payroll − running costs paid
metrics.source: Payments, project expenses, vendor bills, payroll, operating expenses

target.text: Judged by its margin, against the net margin target (F3)

metrics.name: Net margin
metrics.definition: Net profit as a share of revenue collected.
metrics.formula: F2 ÷ F1

target.text: At least 15%

metrics.name: Cash collected (incl. tax and pass-through)
metrics.definition: Money received in the period, the whole of each payment -- tax and pass-through included, so it is more than the revenue collected -- against what was invoiced in it, with the balance overdue at the period's end.
metrics.formula: collected (fee + pass-through + tax) · invoiced · overdue balance at the end

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Client and project margin
metrics.definition: Fee earned in the period less the cost of the period (hours at cost rate, overhead, project costs), as a share of the fee earned. Not judged until a one-off project has logged the share of its estimate set in Settings.
metrics.formula: (fee earned − cost) ÷ fee earned
metrics.source: Fees, retainers terms, time entries, cost rates, project costs

target.text: At least 15%

metrics.name: Revenue at risk
metrics.definition: The monthly fee of retainers past their renewal date with no renewal deal, ending within the next 60 days with no renewal deal, or being renegotiated with no renewal deal. Any one with an open renewal deal is in renewal, listed beside them and left out of this total.
metrics.formula: Σ monthly fee of those retainers
metrics.period: From today on; the period picker does not change it.

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Pipeline from the forecast stage
metrics.definition: Open deals at the forecast stage (Settings) or beyond: their value, and the hours their services take.
metrics.formula: Σ value · Σ reference hours of those deals
metrics.period: From today on; the period picker does not change it.

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Hours coming
metrics.definition: The service reference hours of deals at the forecast stage or beyond, by department, from each deal's expected start.
metrics.formula: Σ reference hours, by department and expected start
metrics.period: From today on; the period picker does not change it.

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

groups.label: Profit leaks
groups.description: Where does money leak between revenue and profit?

metrics.name: Leaked value
metrics.definition: Money lost between revenue and profit: over-used projects, extra revisions, internal time over its allowance, and paid capacity nobody used. Judged as a share of revenue.
metrics.formula: L1 + L2 + L3 + L4; status on F4 ÷ F1
metrics.source: Time entries, cost rates, fees, task history, capacity

target.text: At most 25% of revenue

metrics.name: Over-used projects
metrics.definition: For each project with a fee: the hours at cost spent beyond what the fee earned in the period had left after its direct costs -- never more than the hours themselves cost, so no cost is counted twice. Fee earned is the retainer's monthly fee, or the project's fee times the share of its estimate delivered in the period.
metrics.formula: Σ min(hours × cost rate, max(0, hours × cost rate + direct costs − fee earned)), fee projects
metrics.source: Time entries, cost rates, client accounts, retainers terms

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Extra revisions
metrics.definition: Hours logged on a task after it was sent back more times than the included revision rounds, at each person's cost rate on the day.
metrics.formula: Σ hours after the send-back beyond the included rounds × cost rate
metrics.source: Task history, time entries, cost rates

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Internal time over allowance
metrics.definition: Personal and internal hours beyond the allowance (a share of capacity, set in Control panel → Settings), at the average cost rate of those hours.
metrics.formula: max(0, internal hours − allowance × capacity) × average cost rate

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Idle paid capacity
metrics.definition: Paid hours nobody logged: for each person, capacity less every hour they logged, at their cost rate.
metrics.formula: Σ per person max(0, capacity − logged) × cost rate

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Budget variance
metrics.definition: Running costs confirmed for the period's months less their budgets; above nothing is an overspend.
metrics.formula: Σ running costs − Σ budgets

target.text: Each category's budget for the month
target.where: Finance › Budget: each category's monthly budget

groups.label: Projects
groups.description: Which projects make or lose money, and which are at risk?

metrics.name: Active projects
metrics.definition: Projects in Active status at the end of the period.
metrics.formula: count of Active projects
metrics.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
metrics.type: Stock: as at the end of the period

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Hours on client work
metrics.definition: Hours logged in the period on projects that have a client.
metrics.formula: Σ hours on client projects

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Average margin after overhead
metrics.definition: The margin after overhead of the projects far enough along to judge (fee earned less hours at cost, overhead and direct costs), weighted by the fee each earned in the period. The fee used, beside it, leaves the overhead out. Judged against its own target (Control panel → Insights targets), not the net margin’s.
metrics.formula: Σ (fee earned − cost) ÷ Σ fee earned, judged projects

target.text: At least 45%

metrics.name: Over their fee
metrics.definition: Projects whose fee used to date -- hours at cost and direct costs, without overhead -- is above their fee.
metrics.formula: count of projects with labour at cost + direct costs to date > fee
metrics.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
metrics.type: Stock: as at the end of the period

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Burning ahead of time
metrics.definition: Projects using their fee (hours at cost and direct costs, without overhead; or, without a fee, their estimate) faster than their time passes, by more than the margin set in Settings.
metrics.formula: fee (or estimate) used % > time elapsed % + margin
metrics.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
metrics.type: Stock: as at the end of the period

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

groups.label: Clients
groups.description: Who pays us, how well, and who might leave?

metrics.name: Active clients
metrics.definition: Clients whose status is Active.
metrics.formula: count of Active clients
metrics.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
metrics.type: Stock: as at the end of the period

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Biggest client's share
metrics.definition: The share of the fee earned in the period that the biggest client earned us: the basis is fee earned (as F8 and F9), with the cash share -- the biggest payer's share of what was collected -- in the tooltip.
metrics.formula: biggest client's fee earned ÷ fee earned
metrics.source: Fees, retainers terms, time entries; payments for the cash share

target.text: At most 60%

metrics.name: Top three clients' share
metrics.definition: The share of the fee earned in the period that the three biggest clients earned us; the cash share is in the tooltip.
metrics.formula: top three clients' fee earned ÷ fee earned
metrics.source: Fees, retainers terms, time entries; payments for the cash share

target.text: At most 100%

metrics.name: Revenue concentration
metrics.definition: The biggest client's share of the fee earned in the period (with the top three's beside it). One basis: fee earned, as F8 and F9; the cash collected is in the tooltip, never the figure.
metrics.formula: biggest client's fee earned ÷ fee earned
metrics.source: Fees, retainers terms, time entries; payments for the cash share

target.text: At most 60%

metrics.name: Effective rate
metrics.definition: Fee earned in the period for each hour logged on client work.
metrics.formula: fee earned ÷ hours on client projects

target.text: At least 105 USD/h

metrics.name: Going quiet
metrics.definition: Active clients with no new task, no task approved and no invoice for the number of days in Settings. A client whose every retainer has ended is not quiet: they are lost, and counted there.
metrics.formula: count of Active clients with nothing in N days
metrics.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
metrics.type: Stock: as at the end of the period

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Lost
metrics.definition: Retainers that ended in the six months to the end of the period, with their reasons. One past its renewal date with nothing decided is not lost yet: it stays under renewals until somebody marks it.
metrics.formula: count of retainers ended in six months
metrics.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
metrics.type: Stock: as at the end of the period

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Days sales outstanding
metrics.definition: How many days of invoicing are still unpaid: the balance open at the end of the period against what was invoiced in the 90 days to it.
metrics.formula: receivables ÷ invoiced in 90 days × 90
metrics.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
metrics.type: Stock: as at the end of the period

target.text: At most 45.0 days

metrics.name: Collection rate
metrics.definition: Money received in the period against what fell due in it.
metrics.formula: collected ÷ invoices due in the period

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

groups.label: Forecast
groups.description: What revenue and work is coming? (Clients › Forecast)

metrics.name: Weighted forecast
metrics.definition: Open deals at the forecast stage in Settings or beyond, expected to start in the months ahead, each at its value times its chance of winning (its own, else its stage's in Settings).
metrics.formula: Σ value × chance, deals from the forecast stage on, by expected start month
metrics.period: From today on; the period picker does not change it.

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Open pipeline
metrics.definition: The value of every open deal; coverage is the weighted pipeline of the next three months (value × chance, the deals expected to start in them) against those months' revenue target.
metrics.formula: Σ value of open deals · coverage = weighted pipeline, next 3 months ÷ revenue target, next 3 months
metrics.period: From today on; the period picker does not change it.

target.text: Coverage of 1.2× the next three months' revenue target

metrics.name: Win rate
metrics.definition: Deals won as a share of those won or lost, by count, closed in the period.
metrics.formula: won ÷ (won + lost)

target.text: At least 30%

metrics.name: Average deal
metrics.definition: The mean value of the deals won in the period, those with a value.
metrics.formula: Σ value won ÷ deals won with a value

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Days to close
metrics.definition: The mean days from a deal being made to its win, for those won in the period.
metrics.formula: Σ days from creation to won ÷ deals won

target.text: At most 30.0 days

basis.fees_collected: payments.paid_at — the fee share of each collection, on the day it was collected
basis.project_expenses: project_expenses.spent_at when no bill mirrors it (paid on the spot: that date is the payment); when a bill mirrors it, each part paid on the bill on its own day (vendor_payments.paid_at; round 2.6, owner decision 3), or the bill's paid_at when it was paid whole before parts were recorded
basis.vendor_bills: vendor_payments.paid_at — standalone bills, each part on the day it was paid (a bill paid whole before round 2.5: vendor_bills.paid_at)
basis.payroll: payroll_periods.period, when confirmed — the labelled exception: payroll is booked in the month it is confirmed for (Addendum F section 3), not on a payment date
basis.operating_expenses: operating_expenses.paid_at — on the day they were paid

pnl.basis_sentence: Revenue: the fee part of what was collected. Costs: what was paid, except payroll, which counts in the month it is for.
